mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ is defined in the Oxford Advanced Learner's dictionary 6th edition as "a system of natural justice allowing a fair judgment in a situation where the existing laws are not satisfactory".
Equity is defined in the Oxford Advanced Learner's dictionary 6th edition as "a system of natural justice allowing a fair judgment in a situation where the existing laws are not satisfactory".
Fill in the blank: ______ is an important factor upon which the doctrine of laches is founded.
Acquiescence is an important factor upon which the doctrine of laches is founded.
Fill in the blank: ______ means a special and peculiar department of the English legal system which was created, developed and administered in the Court of Chancery.
Equity in this sense means a special and peculiar department of the English legal system which was created, developed and administered in the Court of Chancery.
Fill in the blank: ______ is a le-gal remedy, and here the payment of rent is evidence of a legal tenancy with a rent not payable by anticipation.
Distress is a le- gal remedy, and here the payment of rent is evidence of a legal tenancy with a rent not payable by anticipation.
fib: ______ is a defence to an action for rectification.
Laches or acquiescence is a defence to an action for rectification.
